title: build-wsl Release positional argument mismatch
body: The documented root README permits ./build-wsl.sh Release, but the wrapper rejects positional Release before configure; the queued baseline had to be retried as ./build-wsl.sh --target test_recipe_glsl_numerical_parity. Align the documented invocation and wrapper parser so a Release witness does not need a manual correction.

title: native VIXEN witness requires unavailable elevation
body: The documented tools/vixen-native.sh prepare route cloned the lane and provisioned Ninja, then stopped with exit 20 because pinned VS Build Tools/Windows SDK needs an elevated PowerShell; the wrapper only reports OWNER ACTION. Provide a queued/native-capability path for pinned toolchain provisioning or a preflight that identifies the missing elevation before spending the clone/provisioning step.

title: WSL CTest launcher skips registered recipe witness
body: Queued Release CTest discovery classifies the recipe executables as GPU and skips the registered RecipeGlslOpcodeCoverage and DeclaredPositionRender cases before launch under WSL, while direct queued gtest filters pass with the documented Dozen ICD. The witness needed a manual direct-binary route; derive CPU-only cases and WSL GPU capability from the test rather than executable-level skip policy.
